validation.mode: CPU/mocked CLI, no production model or audio calls

coverage: Accepted correction retains existing validators provenance and cached wording.
Length-guard rejection differs from deterministic meaning-flag rejection.
Exhausted candidate validation differs from a fatal corrective-call error.
Partial initial-review failure does not invent an attempted correction.
Explicit full fallback approval emits no correction outcome.
initial_test_adjustment: An added assertion exposed an existing inaccurate test comment: an unchanged number flag not classified E by review is suppressed by redo_class, so the rejection was the length guard. Corrected the assertion/comment without changing production behavior.
privacy: Only requested unit IDs and fixed reason labels are added. No transcript, Telugu, candidate, error-message, or media content is recorded.
independent_diff_review: No actionable findings; only trace assignments after existing decisions.
deployment: Existing background engine left running; telemetry takes effect on its next normal launch. No restart solely for instrumentation.
limitations: This is diagnostic instrumentation, not a throughput or quality improvement claim. Existing P/E and timing underfill remain unresolved.
